doc: Object standing on the table: a long shallow tray (rounded-rectangle tube with a thick lip and a sloped inner face, 'lip' wall) whose -x end is a tall thin-walled holder tube (the frame puts the tall end at -x), rows of tapered pegs standing in the tray cavity beyond the holder, marker balls on the outside. The holder clips the tray cavity at its +x outer face. Reproduces hand kit C (prim_rack.build, variant full, single episode) with the default windows.
